artifacts.name: Lily's red woollen hat
artifacts.description: A small hat knitted from chunky red wool, dome-shaped at the crown with a wide turned-back brim of two finger-widths, roughly ten centimetres tall when the brim is turned up, the knit stitches visible as raised ridges across the surface, slightly misshapen from wear

artifacts.name: Moving boxes
artifacts.description: A stack of large plain brown cardboard boxes of varying sizes, the largest roughly sixty centimetres on each side, folded-flap tops either tucked shut or left open, sides creased and slightly bowed from contents, smudged illegible marks on several faces

artifacts.name: Fallen chestnut
artifacts.description: A single horse chestnut roughly four centimetres across, its outer shell split open and peeled away, revealing the smooth mahogany-brown seed inside with a broad pale cream patch on one side where it was attached to the husk

artifacts.name: Kettle
artifacts.description: A compact white plastic electric kettle roughly twenty-five centimetres tall, a broad cylindrical body narrowing slightly at the base, a short spout projecting forward at the upper third, a hinged lid at the top, and a loop handle at the rear, sitting on a circular white plastic base unit

artifacts.name: Mug of tea
artifacts.description: A wide cylindrical ceramic mug roughly nine centimetres tall and eight centimetres across, plain white with a single loop handle on one side, filled with a warm amber-brown liquid to within two centimetres of the rim

artifacts.name: Mislabelled box
artifacts.description: A medium brown cardboard box roughly forty centimetres on each side, open at the top with flaps folded back, the text on one side crossed out in heavy strokes and rewritten beside it in smudged illegible marker

artifacts.name: Log pile
artifacts.description: A stack of split logs roughly a metre and a half tall and two metres wide, the logs cut to lengths of about thirty centimetres and stacked in horizontal rows, pale cream and tan at the cut ends with grey-brown bark on the outer faces, the pile slightly uneven at the top row, a gap of roughly fifty centimetres wide and sixty centimetres tall at one end near ground level where fewer logs have been placed

artifacts.name: Copper-coloured fallen leaves
artifacts.description: Fallen horse chestnut and plane tree leaves in deep copper, burnt orange, and dull gold tones, roughly palm-sized, lying flat or curled at the edges on the ground, scattered unevenly across stone paving and earth

locations.name: The family flat — kitchen and sitting area
locations.description: indoor, ground-floor flat interior. Colors: warm cream walls, pale grey stone floor, honey-toned wooden window frames, brown cardboard boxes, soft amber light. a wide window with a stone sill looking toward the lane, a small kitchen counter with a pale worktop along one wall, stacked moving boxes filling the corners and most of the floor space, a plain wooden table with two chairs visible. Signature: the cluster of stacked moving boxes occupying most of the usable floor space, leaving only narrow paths between them

locations.name: The flat window overlooking the square
locations.description: indoor, looking outward from a first-floor flat window. Colors: pale grey stone window surround, cool blue-grey glass, warm amber interior reflected at the edges, the square and tower visible as muted ochres and greys beyond. a deep stone window sill wide enough to lean against, the glass pane running from sill to lintel, the square and tower visible in the distance through the glass, the lane and rooftops of the Altstadt forming the middle ground. Signature: the Stadtturm visible as a distinct vertical shape rising above the roofline in the far distance beyond the glass

locations.name: The Stadtturm square
locations.description: outdoor, stone-paved public square at the base of the Stadtturm. Colors: grey and buff stone paving, warm ochre tower stonework, copper and gold fallen leaves, overcast pale grey sky. broad flat stone paving stretching across the foreground, a large stone rubbish bin near one edge, low stone kerbs bordering the square, fallen chestnut and plane leaves scattered across the ground, the Stadtturm rising at the rear of the square. Signature: the Stadtturm — a tall rectangular stone gate-tower from the mid-fifteenth century with a pointed roof and a vaulted arch passage at its base forming the northern gate of the Altstadt — rising directly above the square

locations.name: The flat landing
locations.description: indoor, interior stairwell landing of a stone Altstadt building. Colors: pale grey stone steps, warm cream plaster walls, soft diffused natural light from a small high window. a wide stone step serving as a seat, a plain plaster wall behind, the edge of a wooden handrail visible at one side, the corridor continuing in shadow beyond. Signature: the wide stone step used as a low seat against the pale plaster wall

locations.name: The chestnut path to the Holzbrücke

vantages.name: Bridge mouth close at log pile

locations.description: outdoor, tree-lined cobbled path along the Limmat leading to the covered wooden bridge. Colors: deep copper and burnt orange fallen leaves, grey cobblestones, dark brown tree trunks, pale dusk sky in greys and soft orange at the horizon, the bridge mouth a dark warm brown. a row of large horse chestnut trees lining both sides of the path with heavy spreading canopies, fallen leaves covering most of the cobbled surface, the covered wooden bridge visible at the far end of the path, the river Limmat glimpsed dark and grey to one side. Signature: the covered wooden bridge — the Holzbrücke — visible at the path's end: a roofed timber structure spanning the narrowest point of the river gorge, its bridge mouth a dark rectangular opening framed by heavy timbers, the log pile stacked to one side of the entrance

locations.name: Inside the log pile gap
locations.description: outdoor, enclosed nook between the log pile and the bridge mouth timbers. Colors: dark warm brown of timber and bark, dim amber light filtering through gaps between logs, grey stone cobbles at the base. rough-hewn log ends forming the left and right walls of the gap, the heavy timber frame of the bridge entrance forming the back wall, the logs overhead cutting the light to a narrow strip, the cobbled ground level and damp. Signature: the ceiling formed by the overhanging logs just above head height for a small child, making the space feel like a low cave open only at one end
